classification: critic original arbitrary-weight filtering-accuracy assumption failed; bounded proof domain repair, not runtime refutation
taskContract: Actual native R11F_G11F_B10F original FLOAT sampler through unchanged bridge. No arbitrary filtering accuracy or portable f16 filtering rounding promise. Packed surface discrete allowed rounding assertions remain exact and separate.

primarySources.interpretation: Floating computation can be data-format limited; texture formulas define filtering structure without specifying an f32 filtering implementation. No inference of arbitrary f16 rounding contract is made.

Highp controls returned storage precision. Built-ins lacking GLSL equations have undefined precision; textureLod delegates lookup to API texture rules. Therefore highp return type alone does not establish the critic 2e-6 arbitrary-weight accuracy assumption.
